name: Right Now
tagline: Fresh off the For You page

cards.name: Pirate Gaster
cards.caption: Always bet on the Captain
cards.flavor: June 2026: Deltarune fans made W.D. Gaster a pirate captain, sea shanty and all.
cards.art: LeanaLeabian's fan art of W.D. Gaster as a pirate captain, with tricorn, hook, parrot and green cape (KYM's main image).

cards.name: Niu Lai
cards.caption: Here comes the cow
cards.flavor: Aug 2026: a mother-and-son Chinese cartoon about a scared calf, so bad it became a hit.
cards.art: Still of the red cow hero's deadpan face from the 2026 Chinese animated film Niu Lai (Know Your Meme's main image).

cards.name: Bukangi
cards.caption: Won't leave the harbor
cards.flavor: Busan, Sept 2026: a 3 m shark moved into a harbor canal and drew a million visitors.
cards.art: Yonhap aerial news photo of Bukangi the shark swimming past stone bollards in the Busan North Port waterfront canal.

cards.name: Huss Valley
cards.caption: Why he keep coming back?
cards.flavor: July 2026: clips of YouTuber Daniel LaBelle fleeing costumed chasers became 'Huss Valley.'
cards.art: Deep-fried meme frame of Daniel LaBelle as a mailman running from a red dog costume (left panel of Know Your Meme's image).

cards.name: La Peace
cards.caption: That's la peace
cards.flavor: Aug 2026: Kai Cenat said 'lapis' on a Minecraft stream and it came out 'la peace.'
cards.art: The meme edit of Kai Cenat as a white-bearded sage raising one finger in a Minecraft cave (Know Your Meme's main image).

cards.name: Chile Memes
cards.caption: Cars in Chile be like
cards.flavor: Sept 2026: Chile is long and thin, so the internet decided everything there is too.
cards.art: The squeezed-thin teal car in a night parking lot beside a map of Chile (middle panel of Know Your Meme's image).

cards.name: Remember November
cards.caption: Remember November 2026
cards.flavor: Aug 28, 2026: an AI polar bear sings a cryptic prophecy that November 2026 is coming.
cards.art: Close-up frame of the AI polar bear singing, mouth open, from the viral video (Know Your Meme's main image).

cards.name: Steal an Egg
cards.caption: Steal an egg. Run.
cards.flavor: July 2026: Roblox's Steal an Egg launched and hit 14M players at once by September.
cards.art: The game's official Roblox icon: a blocky avatar hoisting a giant golden egg next to a snarling robot jaguar.

cards.name: Black Cat Clapping
cards.caption: Wow. Great job. Really.
cards.flavor: Sept 2026: an AI black cat with human hands slowly applauds. Green-screened everywhere.
cards.art: Frame of the AI black cat grinning with human teeth and clapping its human hands on a tiled floor (Know Your Meme's main image).

cards.name: Verity
cards.caption: It's me, it's Verity!
cards.flavor: May 2026: a Minecraft horror series made Gen Alpha yell 'Verity!' at every smiley face.
cards.art: Screenshot of Verity, the round yellow smiley, floating over Minecraft grass in ThatMob's series (Know Your Meme's main image).

cards.name: AI Rumpelstiltskin
cards.caption: Tip-toein' in my Jordans
cards.flavor: Aug 2026: an AI 'lost 80s film' imp dances in a barn. Set to Riff Raff, it tip-toed viral.
cards.art: Frame of the AI Rumpelstiltskin imp in a velvet tailcoat mid tip-toe dance in a hay barn (NBC News screenshot of the clip).

cards.name: Jimothy
cards.caption: Praise Jimothy!
cards.flavor: July 14, 2026: a round little Seattle raccoon waddled across a backyard into history.
cards.art: Frame from the original July 2026 video of Jimothy the round raccoon on a backyard lawn by a tree (Know Your Meme's main image).
